title: SearchResponse
description: Returned by a hospital node's /api/beacon/query endpoint. Matches architecture.md's 'Two Schema Layers > Search/metadata layer' section. A suppressed match must never carry a raw count.

query_id.description: Echoes the DiscoveryQuery.query_id this response answers.

node_id.description: Identifier of the responding hospital node.

exists.description: Whether any records matched, without revealing a count.

count.description: Exact count when at/above this node's small_cohort_threshold; null when suppressed.

display_count.description: Human-readable count string safe to render, e.g. '<10' or '47'. The Portal must render this, not `count`, so suppression cannot be bypassed.

suppressed.description: True if count was withheld due to small-cohort policy.

suppression_reason.description: Why the count was suppressed, or null when not suppressed.

available_data.description: Data types available at this node if an access request is later approved.

access_request_supported.description: Whether this node currently accepts access requests.
